articleTitle: Virtual Physical Space — An Architecture Supporting Internet of Things Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents a reference architecture known as Virtual Physical Space which can be adapted to build Internet of Things applications in various domains. The close relationship under Cyber-Physical Spaces, Internet of Things and Cyber-Physical-Social Spaces are also discussed. Furthermore, the basic building components of the proposed architecture are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Plug and Play System for Monitoring of Electrical and Non-Electrical Data
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: With the arrival of Industry 4.0 in the industry, it is necessary to integrate it into the ship's monitoring and automation systems. Digital information management in shipping is an inevitable and necessary trend. Compared with the traditional management mode, it is more convenient, efficient and traceable. The most effective data management and maintenance platforms currently are cloud-based technologies. They have the ability to manage and display complete information about the tracked vessel(s), containing data on the technical - economic status available from anywhere in the world, thus allowing for better management. The article proposes an idea and structure of a system for centralized control of objects, including ships.

articleTitle: Microcontroller Based Implementation of Peak Current Control Method in a Bidirectional Buck-Boost DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This work presents the digital implementation of peak current control method in a bidirectional buck-boost DC-DC converter, as an alternative solution to voltage and hysteresis mode control schemes. The advantages of peak current control, such as the constant switching frequency and good performance in both steady state and dynamic response are pointed out. Moreover, an implementation scheme is presented, based on the C2000 Piccolo Launchpad microcontroller unit. Experimental results on a prototype converter are shown, indicating the improved dynamic characteristics of a Type II feedback compensator compared to a PI controller.

articleTitle: Home automation system based on ESP8266
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper describes the implementation of an Internet of Things Home Automation System with energy measurement capabilities. The basic hardware components are the ESP8266 micro-controller by Espressif and energy meter chip HLW8012 by HLW Technology. The Software works over the TCP/IP stack and uses the MQTT protocol to communicate between the devices. The minimum configuration of the HAS includes one control device called Gateway and two or more manageable Host devices. The user friendly, simplified interface is web based. The platform has open software and hardware.

articleTitle: Generalized Net Model of Biometric Identification Process
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In the current paper a generalized net model of the biometric identification is presented. The modeled process contains combination of the steps included in unimodal, multibiometric and hybrid identification systems. The constructed generalized net model can be used for analyzing and simulating the processes included in biometric identification systems. It can be helpful in procedures of managing and optimizing the biometric identification processes. In the second part of the paper a MATLAB implementation of the biometric fingerprint identification is presented.

articleTitle: Simulation Model of Unsymmetrically - Shaped Grounding Grids for Investigation of the Touch Voltages during Lightning Stroke
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Lightning activity is a natural hazard. Protection of equipment and people in electrical power systems depends on the effectiveness of the earthing (grounding) and lightning protection systems. Modeling of the earthing systems of electrical power substations is within the scope of the authors' research work. They have developed a computer model based on Matlab. The purpose is to be obtained the possible contact (touch) voltages in the earthing systems caused by a lightning stroke. The model takes into account the specific processes that develop in the soil. The values for the maximum contact voltage have been published for an earthing grid with a regular shape of the cells and without vertical earthing rods. The paper presents a computer model for investigation of the maximum touch voltage in a rectangular - shaped grounding grid in case of a lightning stroke in different points of the grid. The influence of the impulse wave front of the lightning current has also been investigated.

articleTitle: Distributed Internet of Things System for Wireless Monitoring of Electrical Grids
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this work a distributed internet of things system for electric power consumption monitoring, has been designed. LoRa radio frequency technology is employed with LoRaWAn communication protocol. The system consists of Arduino based distributed measurement devices connected by gateway stations which are transferring data to online cloud server for further processing and visualization on distant portable devices. The system is pointed on industrial internet of things applications e.g. for multi nodal distributed monitoring of electric power supply networks, local smart-grids, etc.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Water Monitoring for a Smart Seaside City
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents a possible platform for Internet of Things monitoring of seawater that can enhance the infrastructure of a Smart Seaside City. Integration of virtual and physical worlds is a distinctive feature of close related Cyber-Physical Spaces, Cyber-Physical-Social Spaces, and Internet of Things. Building platforms that exploit this property would reveal new opportunities for accomplishment the concept of smart city. The proposed platform is implemented as an adaptation of the Virtual Physical Space reference architecture.

articleTitle: Tuning of power system stabilizer PSS3B and analysis of its properties
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The purpose of the power system stabilizers (PSS) is to provide additional damping to the interarea, local and intrastation modes of electromechanical oscillations and thus to improve the small-signal stability of the electric power systems. There are a number of PSS types, standardized by IEEE. The most widely used and commented in the literature stabilizer types are the dual-input, single band PSS2B and the dual-input, multi-band PSS4B. Very scarcely covered in the literature is the dual-input, single-band stabilizer - PSS3B. This paper aims to fill-in the gaps in terms of PSS3B ability to provide good phase compensation for a wide frequency range. Also, to study the frequency-domain response of the PSS in order to verify its filtering properties by testing different configurations of its structure. The results show that PSS3B can provide very good compensation, comparable to PSS2B. However, its filtering properties should be carefully examined because it has certain drawbacks with respect to that.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Electric Processes in Discrete Alternating Step-Voltage Regulators
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents a review on the problems of the analysis of autotransformer discrete alternating voltage regulators. The analysis has been made basically by the state variables approach in the time domain, where the non-linearity of the regulator components has been considered. A special algorithm has been developed for part-by-part solving of the obtained sparse matrix equations with cell structure. Experimental verification with a prototype has been performed, which showed a good correspondence with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of photovoltaic power plant
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents a mathematical model of a photovoltaic (PV) power plant. The model is based on structural approach and consists of PV generator, DC cabling and PV inverter sub models. A model validation and adequacy analysis is performed based on a comparison with actually measured data originating from real life PV power plant. The results witness good computational efficiency and admissible accuracy.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Assessment of Enhanced Frequency Response Services Using Real Frequency Time Series
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents a probabilistic assessment of the novel enhanced frequency response (EFR) service in the transmission system of Great Britain (GB). Real frequency measurements with one-second resolution, released by National Grid (NG) corresponding to the years 2014 and 2015, are used for the performance assessment. Initially, the frequency quality is evaluated against Security and Quality of Supply Standards (SQSS) of NG. Afterwards, battery energy storage systems (BESSs) with different power to energy ratios have been modelled and fed with the GB frequency time-series while providing two variants of EFR service. Then, a state of charge (SOC) management algorithm is implemented for comparison purposes. Finally, cumulative probability distribution functions (CDF) are created to analyse the performance of the BESS. The high utilisation rates obtained for one of the EFR services suggests that for the provision of EFR to be profitable for the providers, the service should refocus towards the post-fault or frequency containment region.

articleTitle: Microclimatic data collection multisensor system for design of energy model in residential buildings
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents a multisensor system for collection and storing microclimatic data for design and verification of energy model in residential buildings. The multisensor system is comprised of eight pairs of multifunctional sensors and a single board microcomputer to collect and store the data. Each multifunctional sensor consists of various circuits to measure temperature, relative humidity, luminosity and barometric pressure. Additionally, external GPS supplies the current date and time to make the system internet independent.

articleTitle: Testing and clearing the high temperature module error from 0 to 1250°C for measurement with 16 K-type thermocouples
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The subject of this paper is a temperature device for measuring 16 temperatures with thermocouples type K in the temperature range from 0 to 1250°C, called “high temperature module for 16 thermocouples”. For this ARDUINO-based device, experiments were carried out on electrically resistive furnaces, with significant errors in temperature measurement inside the furnace. The work is a comparison of the mathematical transformation in the amplifier and its improvement. The design of the module, the experimental study of the module and the results of the tests are described.

articleTitle: Convergence of Technologies of the Evolving Prototype of an Energy Efficient Large-Scale System
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Topical issues of the energy efficiency of advanced technology, elements of ultra-large-scale systems and its evolving prototypes are discussed. We consider system integration as a process. A conceptual model of technology for energy efficient large-scale system based on bioinspired approach are shown. An intention of “windows of possibilities” is determined for exploratory research and development for heterogeneous robotics and etc. In the paper, convergence of mechatronics, electrical engineering, radio engineering is shown in particular problems of design of pre-smart infrastructure (e.g. smart cities). Examples of the integration components of large-scale systems prototypes are presented.

articleTitle: Transformation of NMEA ship network from sensor-based to information-based model
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The considered approach puts users at the center and subordinates the construction of the system to their needs and it will greatly increase the ability to provide information to users in the desired kind and place, together with a full report of their actions, which can help in future analysis and improving their performance. A major advantage of the transition to the specified architecture is the capabilities to integrate architecture into existing systems without compromising their entirety and the ability to fully integrating into the expected new NMEA OneNet standard.

articleTitle: Impact Assessment of Frequency Support by Electric Vehicles: Great Britain Scenario 2025
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: A desire to reduce environmental pollution coupled with advances in battery technology are some of the drivers for the massive growth in the use of Electric Vehicles (EVs) worldwide. The objective of this paper is to assess the impact that large groups of EVs, connected to frequency-responsive charging stations, have on the frequency response of the Great Britain (GB) power system during a sudden generation loss event. The assessment considers the minimum expected system's rotational inertia and the predicted EV charging demand in GB for the year 2025. The developed model employs a representative block for the EV clusters which are formed based on the type of frequency support service they can provide. The effects of the expected EV penetration, type of EV charging, charger delay and sensitivity of the control are evaluated. OPAL-RT has been used to run the simulation and perform the assessment. The simulation results highlighted the positive effects of employing EVs as a distributed energy storage system (DESS) in regards to the system frequency response (SFR).

articleTitle: Sentinel-1 SAR Images of Inland Waterways Traffic
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The present paper contains information on radar observation of Danube river by using satellite-based Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and incoherent pulse radar installed on the Bulgarian bank near city of Ruse. Radar pictures from both sources are presented in the paper. Distance and azimuth resolutions of both radars are examined as well as the quality of pictures with respect to target detection, ranging and identification.

articleTitle: Study of Two MPPT Methods for High Inertia Wind Turbine with Direct Driven PMSG
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The aim of this work is to study and compare two methods for maximum power point tracking (MPPT) for megawatt wind energy conversion systems. The performance of the optimal tip speed ratio control (TSR) and the optimal torque control (OTC) is analyzed using Matlab/Simulink model of a wind turbine with direct driven permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) connected to the grid via full scale back-to-back converter. The simulation results show that the OTC has positive effect to the studied system's stability, minimizing the power fluctuations. The response to wind speed variations of the TSR method is faster but it leads to mechanical stress in the system.

articleTitle: Reduction of IGBT Turn-on Losses via Saturable Choke with F Characteristic of the Magnetic Core
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to present a new approach for reduction of IGBT turn-on losses via the usage of a saturable choke with flat “F” characteristic of the magnetic core. The proposed circuit diagram is an improvement of the well known RLD circuit with snubber inductance. The operation of the diagram with saturable choke is described and an estimation of the reduced turn-on losses of the control semiconductor elements are given.

articleTitle: Fractional activation functions in feedforward artificial neural networks
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Fractional calculus is an important tool for analysis, including physics, biology and artificial intelligence. For some functions, alternative fractional definitions have been developed - the exponential function, trigonometric functions, hyperbolic tangent. But for others, like the logistic sigmoid function, fractional equivalents are not yet studied. Most of the mentioned functions are used as activation functions in artificial neural networks. Using the fractional activation functions provides the networks with more tunable hyperparameters. In this paper, analysis of some fractional functions is made, and the effects of different choices of function parameter values is examined in terms of learning and precision of feed-forward artificial neral networks.

articleTitle: Modelling and Research of High-Efficiency Converter for Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The following paperwork considers modelling and examination of a high-efficiency converter for charging applications in energy storage systems. The converter provides galvanic isolation between the charged storage elements and the supplying DC bus. The high efficiency is due to the circuit soft-switching operation, as well as, to the implementation of a synchronous rectifier as an output stage. Characteristics of the converter operation are obtained. The opportunities for charging current control and voltage balancing between the individual cells are investigated. The obtained simulation results are verified by experimental examinations.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Critical Clearing Time in Low Rotational Inertia Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The growing share of power electronic/converter interfaced generation is decreasing the total system rotational inertia. The reduced rotational inertia in the power system has important impact on the electro-mechanical processes, the power angle and frequency evolution time are quicker resulting in faster transient processes. Rapid response of the protection systems shall be applied, in order to clear the faults in the power systems. This paper aims to identify the roots/mechanism of critical clearing time reduction/deterioration by determining/analyzing the trajectories of the critical clearing time (CCT) in low rotational inertia power systems. In this paper, the equal area criterion (EAC) is used for analysis purposes. Theoretical and practical findings demonstrate the increase of the rotational inertia increases the CCT.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Stratified Model of Virtual Semantic Environment for Modifiable Vehicesl
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper we discuss the diversified approaches in the design of elements stratified models of modifiable vehicles. Principals of designing and developing, multi-aspect modeling of infrastructure solutions at energy landscape and identikit of modifiable vehicles are considered. In the beginning, a brief review of the two levels of a virtual semantic environment is given. Obviously, the proposed stratified model is aimed at further developing and filling more levels and elements. Also, we propose some possible cases of data envelopment analysis application in this model. The integration components of the virtual semantic environment complement the specific examples of a software implementation of this approach.

articleTitle: E-Bayesian Point Estimation and Comparative Analysis of the Operational Reliability Related to Electronic Items for Medical Purpose
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper is focused on the medical items reliability analysis and comparison of the evaluated reliability indices per three types of measuring items containing electronic and mechanical modules. The analysis is based on the study of exponential model parameters by means of reliability parametric E-Bayesian estimation. The point estimation values of operational reliability indices valid for the medical items under study are experimentally obtained. This paper is presented an extension of previous research concerning the E-Bayesian evaluation of medical equipment operational reliability.

articleTitle: Adaptive Velocity Control for a Differential Drive Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper proposes an adaptive velocity controller for a differential drive mobile robot during path following applications. First, a dynamic model including actuator dynamics with respect to the robot linear and angular velocities is derived. The controller is designed using model-reference adaptive control method in order to compensate for the uncertainties in the dynamic parameters of the robot and the actuators. The stability of the closed-loop system is analyzed based on Lyapunov stability theory. Simulation and experimental results are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed adaptive control scheme.

articleTitle: Thermoelectric Generator Power Prediction Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Thermoelectric generators are devices making use of the effect of Seebeck. They directly convert the temperature difference ΔT to electric power. The present paper offers a neural network for the prediction of the voltage generated by a Seebeck module at various temperature differences. For this purpose, real experimental results were used.

articleTitle: The lithium polymer battery swelling test with high-precision displacement sensors
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The inappropriate charge-discharge of lithium polymer batteries or the high number of cycles (degradation) can lead to volume expansion. The principal motivation is to precisely determine the beginning and the causes of this expansion. During the research one of the objectives is to create a measurement system which can sample the deformation occurring in the course of charge and discharge. The other main aim is to process the measured results and to detect the conditions which critically influence the lifespan of the battery.

articleTitle: Providing Medical Apparatus with a High Reliability at the Design Stage
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This article suggests a practical approach to the number of backup elements optimization within electronic devices, regarding which high level of reliability requirements have been set. The approach suggested is especially suitable for application in medical electronic devices for mobile use, when there are some additional important factors such as volume and weight. An approach is established by which the backup variants existed are explored consecutively in terms of reliability, and the most suitable case is selected by carrying out an optimization task in compliance with previously defined additional requirements.

articleTitle: Seismic Analysis of High Voltage Bushing
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this work a numerical seismic analysis of high voltage transformer bushing for 245kV voltage is performed. We developed an approach combining three types of finite element method modal analyses: random vibration, response spectrum and harmonic response. Ansys-Workbench software is used for the finite element modeling. Results for material deformation, local acceleration and vibration spectra are obtained and analyzed.

articleTitle: Design of Saturable Choke for Reduction of IGBT Turn-on Losses
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to present a design methodology for dimensioning a saturable choke with flat “F” characteristic of the soft magnetic material, which is connected in series with the IGBT, to reduce the dynamic turn-on losses at switching mode of the transistor.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Analysis of HTS Generator with Bulk Superconductor
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents an electromagnetic analysis of electric generator with bulk high temperature superconductor (HTS) taking into account nonlinear properties of HTS. Calculation includes the process of HTS bulks magnetization inside the inductor, which is needed to create the superconducting rotor with trapped magnetic field. Performance of generator with HTS bulks is analyzed using calculated distribution of magnetic field and torque. Obtained results are compared with the parameters of generator with permanent magnets on the rotor.

articleTitle: Nano-Core-Shell Technologies Suitable for Thin Film Transistors Implementation
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel type of technology involved in the Thin Film Transistors (TFT) fabrication, using ferrite-Nano-Core-Shell-multilayer (NCS) materials. In a first stage, the applied technology of the nanomaterial synthesis is depicted. Primary core-shell np's ferrite nano-particles (Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>0<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) is processed by self-assembling of an external shell with organic compound (PABA - para-aminobenzoic acid). Dynamic Light Scattering characterization reveals a hydrodynamic width of 70.9nm and a high zeta potential of 51.6 mV, indicating high stability of the technology. The material applications in TFT is in progress. Therefore, some Atlas simulations capture the static characteristics and superior performances for transistor with nano-core-shell material. Either NCS or Poly-Silicon, the current vectors flow thru a TFT device proves the main conduction way and the device functionality.

articleTitle: Distribution of the electromagnetic field in a metal disc, located on a three-phase induction device
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Induction heating is a widely used method for thermal treatment. It is characterized by the possibility to provide local heating for specific areas of the treated workpiece and has a relatively high efficiency. The use of three-phase induction devices, however, remains limited due to the problems related to load symmetrization and, in some cases, to the occurrence of a rotating magnetic field. The device proposed in this research work eliminates the above problems. The present work investigates the distribution of the electromagnetic field in a three-phase induction device under load, which is a ferromagnetic disk.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Influence of Magnetron Sputtered Coatings on the Electrodynamic Forces of Current-Carrying Busbars
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In current-carrying parts of electrical apparatus, under certain conditions, large currents are transferred, which also define large electrodynamic forces striving to distort the current contours. The most severe is the short-circuit regime where the electrodynamic forces are proportional to the square of the short-circuit breaking current. As a result of their action the temperature of the elements increases, the mechanical strength decreases and a very heavy mechanical load regime is formed. This also determines the increased requirements for the materials for current-carrying busbars. Interesting from a practical point of view is the question of how a given coating affects the magnitude of the electrodynamic force. The use of protective coatings on heterogeneous materials can result both in the modification of the surface layer material which enhances the performance of the workpiece and in the formation of some new composite materials having both high strength and sufficient plasticity as well as increased wear and corrosion resistance. This leads to improvement of some of the operating parameters in the contact area of the current-carrying busbars. It is also important to assess the influence of the coatings on the magnitude of the electrodynamic force, which is also the subject of this research.

articleTitle: An Approach to Choosing an Optimal IT Infrastructure in Accordance with an Assignor's Requirements
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents the author's approach to choosing the optimal IT infrastructure based on an assignor's requirements. An essential part of the approach is the design of a highly reliable data center for the purposes of a micro, small or medium enterprise. The approach is adapted for practical application. Software tools for its application have been developed.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerance of a Laboratory Computer Cluster
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper discusses the research on fault-tolerance of a laboratory computer cluster, which is designed and built by lecturers and students in the courses of Computer Architectures and Fault-tolerant Computer Systems in Burgas Free University. The cluster consists of four single-board computers Raspberry Pi 3, and is used for research on its fault-tolerance in condition of degradation and reconfiguration by simulating failures. Some of the experimental results are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: An Examination of the Effects of Distributed Generation on Distribution Systems by Load Flow Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Nowadays, obtaining electrical energy from renewable energy resources has become an important issue, mainly because the increasing demand for electrical energy from fossil sources leads to environmental problems and rapid depletion of these sources. Rapidly developing technology makes efficient production of electrical energy from renewable sources possible, so these sources have become appealing for electrical energy production. Renewable energy sources such as wind and solar have an indefinite production characteristic which leads to instantaneous changes in the power system when they are used. These instantaneous changes can damage the stability of power systems. To eliminate these threats, effective plans must be put in place. With load flow analysis, bus voltages and power flows can be determined for variable loading and production cases. Thus, important information can be obtained for the necessary system planning. In this study, using the Newton-Raphson numerical method, an hourly load flow analysis was performed in a system that included renewable energy resources in addition to continuous energy production, and the daily voltage level and power factor changes of the buses were determined.

articleTitle: Steady state transient response evaluation of a first order dynamic circuit on a ground of short series experimental data
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In the paper an approach is proposed for transient process study in a first order (R-C type) dynamic circuit. By processing only a short series of experimental data obtained it is shown how the steady state response can be evaluated. This way it becomes possible substantially to decrease the experiment labor. A specific application of Least Squares Method (LSM) for the processed data series is described to get the best prognostic value of the steady state response in question. Analyses are provided for the influence of the deviations caused by inaccuracy of different type during the experiment.

articleTitle: FPGA Based Neural Networks for Characters Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The current paper presents an FPGA based artificial neural network (ANN) for character recognition. Implementation of the neural network in programmable logic brings a fast speed for character recognition that is difficult to be achieved with standard processor or DSP. The operation of the neural network is verified and tested using an FPGA device.

articleTitle: Soft Starter Circuit Design for Single Phase Squirrel Cage Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Single phase squirrel cage induction motor (SPIM) is widely used in both domestic and industrial applications because of its rough and simple structure. Different kinds of applications bring different optimal operating condition requirements. Starting of the single phase motor with the direct-line connection causes high starting current, high torque ripple in many applications. Because of these drawbacks, motor starting control with the power electronic circuits is needed where the soft starting is required. In this study, a soft starter circuit for a single phase motor is designed, implemented and the main outputs of the drive circuit are presented.

articleTitle: Energy Management Algorithm for Peak Demand Reduction
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Peak demand is an important issue for power systems. Because, marginal cost of supply might increase due to the continuous increase in peak demand. Besides, peak demand might give rise to the power outages. The residential sector is one of the most important sectors affecting the peak demand. Along with the continuous increase in residential loads, peak demand causes adverse effects to the stability and reliability of a power system. The investigation for peak load reduction methods in residential sector contributes to the international efforts in reducing energy consumption. Moreover, demand side management and demand response in residential sector play a key role in reducing peak demand. Hence, load management system was performed to analyze the effects of the demand response for residential sector using Matlab/Simulink in this study. Some residential loads such as washing machine and dishwasher were shifted from peak times to off-peak times using energy management system in order to reduce peak demand. According to the results, the electricity saving is 6.5063 kWh during on-peak times.

articleTitle: Application of the drive systems through the stepper motors in the process equipment, manipulators and pushers without feedback
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The current trend in the development of electric drive systems is the replacement of mechanical transmissions and kinematic connections by electric ones, that is, the fusion of an electric motor with a working element (actuating element). The main advantage of a stepper motor is the ability to realize precise positioning and speed control without applying feedback (speed, position). The limitation in the use of stepper motors is power and speed, but in practice, their use is entirely justified in inexpensive machine tools having a CN C system designed for processing wood, plastics, light metals and other materials of medium speed, the need for manufacturers of CNC machines for accuracy and speed. A conveyor line was developed on a system of stepper motors without feedback for the pharmaceutical industry.

articleTitle: Evaluation and analysis of fog dispersion under the influence of an electric field
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this work, the steam droplets dispersion was evaluated under the influence of an alternating current field through a flyback transformer in an experimental fog chamber. The main objective is to design a high voltage and frequency transformer to disperse fog in the environment. The dispersion was evaluated through reliability levels by using t-distribution for 3 optical sensors inside the chamber. The charged particles were produced around a corona discharge for 3 different trials: flyback turned off and turned on during all the trial, and flyback turned on at the half of the trial. The results obtained show a reliability level of 1.27σ for the lower optical sensor and 1.59σ for the upper optical sensors.

articleTitle: Experimental and Numerical Studies of the Heating in a Low Voltage Switchboard
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents both a numerical and an experimental study of the heating in a closed low voltage switchboard (LVS). Experimental installation is developed for testing the heating in a LVS with a possibility for real time computer aided measuring of the temperature. A computer model has been developed in Comsol for conducting the numerical part of the study. The obtained experimental results and numerical data have been compared for different current loads.

articleTitle: Obtaining Resonance Frequency and Corresponding Circuit Parameters in an Induction Heating System
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The high efficiency of the systems based on induction heating can be achieved if resonant frequency is provided. In the present paper, an approach employing the finite element method is proposed for determination of the main parameters of LC circuit, necessary to reach the resonance frequency.

articleTitle: Development Status and Trend of Control system and Intelligent Equipment for greenhouse
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Greenhouse horticulture helps agricultural products to grow more efficiently and keeps them high quality. Based on analysis of available equipment and control system, this paper summarized the advantages and disadvantages of various equipment used in greenhouse and puts forward future development trend of intelligent greenhouses. The intelligent control system of heating, cooling and irrigation is analyzed. Then, intelligent equipment of each system is summarized. Finally, the existing problems was put forward and development trend was looked forward to.

articleTitle: Using a Long Time Constant Integrator in Rainfall Intensity Measuring via Acoustic Method
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In the present article is proposed a simplified approach for determining the rain intensity, based on acoustic method. A piezo plate is used as a probe, and a long time constant voltage integrator and comparator circuits are the major blocks of the developed sensor. As a reference, a weighing method, based on a strain gauge is used. The main blocks of the sensor are described, and a series of real time measurements are presented.

articleTitle: Wireless Controlled Solar Array Simulator
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Solar panels/arrays are an important integral part of European Union (EU) electrical grid. Their interaction with the grid and behavior under different operational conditions are to be examined more closely at a scientific laboratory complex. A solar array simulator (SAS) is developed with the use of a power electronic DC-DC converter. A control and wireless communication are established with an FPGA platform. As a result the output parameters of the simulator are accessed remotely through graphic user interface. A comparison is made of SAS output characteristics and I-V curve of a given photovoltaic array. The results are then summarized graphically and tabularly.

articleTitle: Log-normal shadowing model for outdoor propagation between sensor nodes
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Here we present outdoor propagation of wireless sensor nodes in different scenarios. “Log-normal shadowing model” is used here for predicting large-scale coverage for wireless sensor networks. Applying this model we can estimate the energy capacity of WSN (wireless sensor network), before such systems to be deployed.

articleTitle: DC-link voltage Control for a Three-Phase Active Infeed Converter with Power Decoupling Circuit
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Reducing the DC-link capacitance of a voltage source converter (VSC) by means of an active power decoupling circuit - also known as power pulsation buffer (PPB) - affects the structure of the voltage control loop. In this paper a three-phase two-level IGBT converter in conjunction with a shunt type PPB based on a bidirectional SiC buck/boost converter is investigated. Measured DC-load current and calculated AC-grid instantaneous power are used as feed-forward variables to improve the transient performance while reducing the PPB loading. Hence the system can handle DC-load steps in the range of its nominal current without experiencing large voltage excursions. Combining both IGBT and SiC technology reflects in the actuators individual dynamic behavior which is justified by a factor of 16 in switching frequency. Although the PPB actuator serves as the main contributor directly after the load-step time instant, the VSCs dynamic is of major importance for long term stability and PPB auxiliary capacitor sizing. The system analysis presented here gives an elementary insight in designing the voltage controllers and shows the dependencies between both VSC and PPB actuator while stabilizing the DC-link voltage. Small signal transfer function for the VSC actuators is evolved and used in the design process. Averaging modelling technique is adopted to verify the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Digital Model of a Document in a University Document Repository
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The building of a centralized university document repository is a challenge posed by multiple factors - heterogeneous processes and procedures where users and applications with different rights create and use diverse documents. The article presents a model of a document in a digital repository. It supports heterogeneous metadata that facilitates the search for and use of documents by users and external systems and their automated retrieval for the needs of various institutional procedures.

articleTitle: Investigation of Sensors for Use in the Management System of Earthmoving and Construction Machines
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper describes sensors of various types for use in the operation control system of earthmoving and construction machines. As a result of the research authors found out that the most rational for earthmoving and construction machines is the use of potentiometric sensors.

articleTitle: The Operation of a Three-Phase Induction Motor in Single-Phase Power Supply Under Smith's Scheme
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The operation of a three-phase induction motor in single-phase power supply under Smith's scheme is considered. Expressions have been obtained to determine the capacitance and voltages of the capacitors, where symmetric three-phase systems of voltages and currents can be obtained for all slip values. Several results are presented to illustrate the performance of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Architecture of Mobile Online: an Application for Creating Mobile Versions of Web Pages
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Much of the web pages don't have mobile versions. This is a problem for users who access them via mobile devices. Mobile Online is an application that automatically creates mobile versions of web pages. The article presents the application architecture and describes the main components and the application work process.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Field Analysis of a Hybrid Electromagnetic System with Magnetic Flux Modulation with One Permanent Magnet and Two Collecting Coils
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In the present work hybrid electromagnetic systems with magnetic flux modulation are investigated. Through computer modelling their main characteristics are defined and the influence of the built-in permanent magnet on them is obtained.

articleTitle: $\pmb{3\mathrm{D}}$ Coupled Electric-Thermal Analyis of Bolted Busbar Connections
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The present paper presents 3D coupled electric-thermal analysis of 5 typical configurations of bolted busbar connections, with the influence of the contact resistance in the overlapped zone with the bolts pressure is taken into account. Steady-state and transient modes of operation have been studied and temperature field distributions as time-dependent results are obtained and been presented. Time-constants for the modeled cases have been calculated, based on the results of the transient analyses. The influence of the reduced contact force in the bolts as well as the increased contact resistance on the thermal performance of the connections are also discussed.

articleTitle: Analytical Comparison of Bluetooth Low Energy Beacons
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Present paper discusses the Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) beacons comparison process. Approximately 85 devices were compared by different parameters given by manufacturers. There is comparison of transmission power, expected life in years and calculated average energy consumption. The most commonly used Systems on Chips (SoC) and batteries are shown. Misleading points are also discussed. Analytical conclusions have been made, helping to select the right beacon.

articleTitle: A model for optimisation of the production structure in a power system
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: A model is described for bottom-up optimization of the production structure in an electric power system comprising micro, small and large units connected accordingly to the low, medium and high voltage networks/grids, which supply non-elastic consumers. The objective function aims for minimization of supply costs, based on producer bids and subject to the constraint of active energy balance. The model is verified by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Fault section estimation in electric power distribution system with Elman neural network
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this article is investigated 6 kV distribution system in large pumping station. Novel method for patterns development with fault trees modeling is presented too. Minimal paths are used for representing of normal working conditions and successful fault clearance. Neural network with back propagation of error (BPNN), neural network with radial basis transfer function (RBNN) and Elman recurrent neural network (Elman NN) behaviors are investigated for finding faulted sections using data from circuit breakers and relay protections. During education and simulations was used big data set, consisting 7225 patterns. For experiments are prepared sets of input vectors, consisting condition of circuit breakers and corresponding relay protections, which are modified input patterns with added Hamming distance as a disturbance. Modeling of missing data (Hamming distance on 1), overlapping of cascading events (Hamming distance on 0), and random case of distribution system condition influence to SCADA system operation (Random Hamming distance on 0 or 1) was tested with BPNN, RBNN and Elman NN. Results are showing that Elman NN can be used for fault section estimation (FSE).

articleTitle: Generalized Net Model of Virtual Collaboration Space
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: As a discrete tool for universal description of adaptable, flexible, structured and reusable models of complex systems, generalized nets have been applied to modeling of various practical aspects of education and scientific research. Here, in continuation of previous research in this area, generalized nets (GN) have been used for development of a model of the process of personalization and adaptive usage of an intelligent virtual collaboration space. In the model, significant role is assigned to the Personal Assistant, which is a component in the context-dependent environment for delivery of e-services, e-learning content and collaboration. Assessments and patterns can be derived based on the GN model developed and the statistical data absorbed from real processes concerning the servicing of the virtual collaboration space.

articleTitle: Cubature Kalman Filter-Based Speed Sensorless Control of Induction Machines
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper, a new speed sensorless control algorithm is introduced for induction machine (IM) drives, which utilizes the cubature Kalman filter (CKF) as state estimator. The CKF is a relative new approach to nonlinear state estimation, which uses a spherical-radial cubature rule in order to compute numerically the multivariate moment integrals. Using an augmented state space model of the IMs, CKF provides load torque estimation and sufficient control performance under difficult operating conditions. The proposed control algorithm is validated by MATLAB simulation in this work.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Influence of the Technological Parameters on the Magnitude of the Electrical Contact Resistance of Current-Carrying Busbars with Magnetron Sputtered Thin Coatings
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In many cases, operating conditions for low and medium voltage busbars are characterized by extreme electrical, cyclic and temperature loads and the presence of chemically active environment. The requirements for busbar materials are increased due to high loads and high operating temperatures. The use of a suitable coating and a method for its application can significantly increase the durability of the current-carrying busbars while maintaining their basic electrical and thermal characteristics. This, however, also alters the magnitude of the electrical contact resistance in the contact area. Interesting from a practical point of view is finding the optimal combination of technology, coating and magnitude of the electrical contact resistance, which is also the subject of this research.

articleTitle: An Approach to the Electrical Sizing of The Electric Motorcycle Drive
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Motor vehicles driven on electricity are rapidly gaining ground in practice. For the urbanized environment, electric motorcycles are especially suitable. The reliability, range and speed of the motorcycle depend on the correct choice of the type, power and torque of the electric motor. The load on the electric motor is the highest at the start. There are a number of approaches to electrical sizing of the electric motor and its adjacent components. However, the data obtained are primarily theoretical without experimental confirmation. The object of the present study is the electrical sizing of the electric motorcycle drive with a practical assessment of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Cyber-Physical Power System of Micro Smart Grid on the base of transformer substation 7000kVA
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Interactive cyber-physical power system with information about the state of protective equipment of smart transformer substation 10/0,4 7000 kVA is discussed. This transformer substation is a part of distribution network of MPEI. Realized system corresponds online internet monitoring of electric energy of object, similarly system of electric supply of the main the television and radio complexes of Russia. This system gives complete state history during to the pre-fault and post-fault conditions, viewing measured items form of table, waveforms and spectra. Information of voltage failures quantity, overvoltage and voltage impulses is saved in graphic and text files. Controllable parameters and all regular and emergency events are displayed on block of special screen forms, one-line diagram of animation and color change. Remote access through the Internet to real production equipment[1] has allowed to create essentially new educational infrastructure of educational process for various electro technical specializations of higher educational schools of Russia and the different branch educational centre's for various level and to acquaint community of electrical engineers with potential possibilities of an ONLINE OF POWER QUALITY PARAMETERS.

articleTitle: RF Performance Analysis of Carbon-Based Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper performance analysis of the carbon-based interconnects in the radio frequency (RF) range is made using parameterized SPICE computer models. Frequency dependent parameterized RLC models of a multilayer GNR interconnect and a CNT interconnect are created, as well as an accurate computer interconnect model based on two-port representation. Based on the obtained resistance values for CNT and GNR interconnects, the ABCD transmission parameters in the RF range can be calculated. The results are compared to other research data and thus have been verified. A comparison is made with data from copper interconnect in the same technology nodes.

articleTitle: Modelling of uninterruptible work cycle of controllable electric loads
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper two approaches for the modeling of controllable loads operation are described. The uninterruptible working cycle of a controllable load imposes certain additional constraints. Such operation cycle is commonly modeled via additional artificial binary variables that further increase the complexity of the initial optimization problem. An approach for the reduction of these inconveniences is proposed with a modification of the balance constraint and further post-optimization processing of the obtained solution.

articleTitle: Application of the Fuzzy Logic for Information Analysis in Communication Networks and Systems for Power Utility Automation
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents an opportunity for application of the Fuzzy Logic for analysis of the information flows from the Supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, which support the operation of power system facilities (power plants, power substations). The paper provides an example and formulates the practical problem related the information analysis. A solution based on the application of the fuzzy logic theory is proposed.

articleTitle: An Application of Hierarchical Method Approach of Self Clustering Algorithm Using Self Organizing Map Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper describes an application of a self-clustering algorithm using hierarchical Self Organizing Map neural network. Data from different training sets are used which are compared with other optimization algorithms for preliminary calculation of the clusters' number. The results from the tests are shown in graphics. As a final result we have a well-trained network based on the topology of the data set.

articleTitle: Parameterized Study of High-Frequency Welding System
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper deals with parameterized modeling of processes in an induction heating system for high frequency longitudinal pipe welding. The investigation has been carried out in order to estimate factors influencing the welding process, required energy and system efficiency. Time harmonic electromagnetic and transient thermal fields have been studied and distribution of the magnetic flux density, eddy currents, power losses and temperature distribution have been obtained for a number of values of system parameters: applied current, welding frequency, welding speed, and dimensions of the heat affected zone, corresponding to the `vee' angle. The presence and position of the ferrite impeder have been also taken into account. The problem was considered as coupled electromagnetic and temperature field problem taking into account real, 3D geometry of the system and has been solved using the finite element method and COMSOL 5.2 software package.

articleTitle: Optimization of Lighting Distribution in Road Lighting Luminaire
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: An approach for optimal design of light distribution of road lighting lumrnaire with LEDs as light source is introduced. The highest possible average illuminance is obtained with a given set of LEDs by varying the orientation of each elementary light source. The way of overcoming the large scale problem is described in details as well as some practical considerations for constructing such kind of a luminaire.

articleTitle: Corner 2D Capacitance
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The 2D geometric corner permeance (capacitance or conductance) was introduced for easier accurate calculation of magnetic and electric circuits containing regions with strong non uniform field. For infinitely long both arms of the corner and for infinitely long one arm and zero length of the other one, exact formulas for geometric corner permeance were derived and for short one arm and the length of the other one equal to zero or infinite good approximate formulas were proposed. In this paper the case of both short arms is studied by finite element method and a new approximate formula is proposed. Thus the problem of rectangular corner parameters is completely solved.

articleTitle: Design Consideration of Induction Brazing Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The process of induction brazing is a dedicated application of the induction heating which requires special attention during the estimation and design of the systems used to apply it. This comes from the specific requirements defined by the materials properties used and by the needs of specific temperature profile required during the process. In this paper we will review the key moments during design of the induction brazing systems by means of power converters and it's matching to the load. Achieving of the maximum efficiency and effectiveness of the energy transfer is the main goal.

articleTitle: Influence of the Heating on the Force of a Solenoid Actuator with T-Shaped Armature
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The study carried out in the paper is connected with electromagnetic actuator having T-shaped moving part. Results from both numerical and experimental studies of the way the winding heating influences the magneto-motive and the electromotive force are given. The numerical data are obtained with the help of a 3D computer model. The optimum current load on the winding is defined, at which maximum electromagnetic force is obtained in case of a boundary winding temperature.

articleTitle: Characteristics of IPMSM in constant torque and field-weakening mode
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The effect of permanent magnet segmentation in Internal Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machines (IPMSM) on the speed range in the constant torque region and flux-weakening region has been investigated. The motor performance of IPMSM with integral and with segmented permanent magnets has been compared. Maximum torque per ampere control strategy has also been applied for both constructions and the effect on the copper loss of the motor and its torque-speed characteristic has been analyzed.

articleTitle: Study of Three-Phase Axial Flux Generators
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Programming simulations by the finite element method Femm 4.2 have been made along with experimental studies of three types of especially crafted three-phase axial flux generators with rare-earth magnets. The e.m.f. and the full active power have been both calculated and measured for the three types of generators. The obtained models simulate with good precision the operation of the studied generators. Economical assessment of the generators has been carried out and it has been found that the generator with two rotors and one stator is the most appropriate for applying in wind-generating systems.

articleTitle: Investigation and Evaluation of Coupling Effect of BPL Transmission Units in MV Cable Network
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The article discusses the basic principles of BPL-PLC transmission paying attention to the limitations of its efficiency in medium voltage cable networks. A way of performing appropriate tests concerning the effectiveness of using the right way of the modem coupling with the cable line has been described. Based on the results obtained, respective practical conclusions have been formulated.

articleTitle: Assessment of non-stationary harmonic distortion related to adjustable speed induction motor and soft starters
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Time-varying harmonic distortion of induction motor soft-starter was exemplarily assessed by most common signal processing techniques like Short-time Fourier Transform, Wavelet Packet Transform and Kalman Filtering. Furthermore the resonance phenomena are considered that appear the grids with power factor correction supplying induction motors with soft-starters.

articleTitle: Generalized Net Model for Building Responsive Design of Web Pages
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The task of automated creation of mobile versions of websites that do not have responsive design becomes more and more popular. The article presents a generalized net model for building mobile content. The model was successfully used in the Mobile Online app. It can be implemented in mobile browsers and software tools to generate real-time mobile web page design.

Author Keywords: generate a mobile version of a web site

articleTitle: Application of dSPACE Platform in the Study of Electric Generators with RES
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents the possibilities of application of dSPACE microprocessor platform for the study of electric generators using renewable energy sources (RES). The platform consists of a hardware part and software that allow easy and fast programming and testing of custom control and simulation programs. One very important option is integration with Matlab/Simulink RTI, which enables the rapid prototyping of control algorithms that are developed and simulated in Simulink.

articleTitle: Semi-automated system updates deployment solution assuring zero business disruption
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Business continuity and availability are top priority for IT. Providing sustainable availability, confidentiality and integrity of all services and resources within associates and counterparts is a key concept to be in the “Leaders” quadrant. Conventionally system updates are being underestimated, delayed or forcefully applied lacking any prior research, analysis nor testing. This paper would glance over an approach providing a flexible and consistent update deployment infrastructure and up-to-date clients, while assuring close to 0 business disruption and having latest critical and security updates in place protecting the organization from current exploits.

articleTitle: Parameters and torque ripple of synchronous reluctance motors with different rotor topology
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The investigation of the effect of magnetic flux barriers shaping and disposition on the performance of synchronous reluctance motors has been shown in the paper. The effect of barrier's ends variation is shown. The influence of minimization of stator slot opening has been also analyzed and its significant improvement of the saliency, efficiency and power factor of the motor has been represented.

articleTitle: Phase Shift Tuning for Measurement of Hysteresis Losses in Inductors with Magnetic Core
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The study presents a method for tuning the phase-shift during measurement of hysteresis losses. It allows to make sure that the two voltages, representing the magnetic field B and the field intensity H, are in-phase, in order to correctly obtain the losses in the magnetic core. For this reason the phase shift is estimated for the fundamental component. With the use of two carefully sized low-pass filters, the two voltages are made inphase and the attenuation is estimated. The method is then applied on an inductor with a magnetic core for different frequencies of the sinusoidal signal in order to obtain the losses due to hysteresis.

articleTitle: Specific Features of the Design of a Small Resistive Art Glass Melting Furnace
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper proposes an algorithm for the design of a small glass melting resistive furnace with two technological modes - in a crucible or in prepared in advance gypsum form for ready glass sculpture producing. In the second case, the tempering of the finished product takes place in the same furnace i.e. the device is also used as a tempering furnace. The methodology has been verified using numerical modelling and experimental studies of a physical model.

articleTitle: Generalized Net Model of Sequential Programs
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The article presents a generalized net model of sequential programs. As a result, generalized net sequential programs are defined. The syntax and semantics of such programs are outlined. In order to define the syntax, reduced generalized nets are used. The semantics is defined by applying Kripke's model, used in propositional dynamic logics. Possible applications of the suggested model are discussed.

articleTitle: A Nothing on Insulator - NOI - Nanotransistor Configuration Suitable for the Zaidman Model
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents an alternative configuration of an atypical Silicon On Insulator (SOI) device with a vacuum cavity. In order to simulate carriers transport in vacuum electronic devices, the Silvaco tools recommend Zaidman model. In previous studies we obtained a null drain current through a Nothing On Insulator (NOI) transistor, if Zaidman model is adopted. The reasons come from the model conditions: the injected electrons in vacuum follow the electric field lines till they leave the vacuum and reach a metallic contact. This condition is in agreement with the vacuum triode configuration, having a metallic collector. If the drain region, which fulfill the collector role, is defined as conductor instead semiconductor, the drain current of this Nothing On Insulator transistor becomes non-null by Zaidman's model. The source region is kept as semiconductor island. For the first time, the NOI static characteristics are presented in this Zaidman compatible case.

articleTitle: Automated system for measurement of natural lighting and utilization of the results for lighting control
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In the recent years the idea of human centric lighting is gaining popularity. This idea is based on the non-visual effect that light have on people, which can adjust their daily rhythms and improve their motivation, well-being and productivity. The simplest way of achieving human centric lighting is by maximum use of the natural daylight. Except for the positive influence of the daylight on people it has another advantage - it naturally leads to energy efficiency of lighting systems, because it leads to reduced demand for lighting from artificial sources. In order to estimate the gain of illuminance by natural lighting on the work plane, it should be measured or simulated. The current paper presents an automatic lighting measurement system, which is programmed to measure both horizontal and vertical illuminances on the working plane of premises. The results received from the system are analyzed and used for development of a lighting control strategy.

articleTitle: Single-phase Two-rotor Axial Generator with Rotating Permanent Magnets in the Stator
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Programming simulations by means of the finite element method Femm 4.2 and experimental studies of two especially crafted single-phase two-rotor axial generators with and without rotating magnets in their stator windings have been carried out. The obtained models simulate the operation of the studied generators with good precision. The change in the construction, namely, the addition of rotating magnets in the stator windings and the replacement of the big rotor magnets by smaller ones both in volume and in accumulated magnetic energy reduces the cost price of the suggested generator in comparison to the one without rotating magnets, improving its electrical characteristics at the same time.

articleTitle: Researching the characteristics of the magnetoelectric position sensor for automotive application
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the study of magnetoelectric crankshaft position sensor based on magnetostrictive-piezoelectric layered material of macro fiber composite - Metglas composition. The main advantages of such a sensor are smaller size and weight. Macro fiber composite active length was of 40 mm, active width was of 5 mm; Metglas length was of 40 mm, the width was of 7 mm; the thickness of magnetoelectric layered structure consisting of the macro fiber composite plus 3 layers of Metglas was of 0.37 mm. The designed crankshaft position sensor showed the output peak voltage pulse about 1.5 V this result allows to use proposed sensor in the control system of the car.

articleTitle: Eddy current losses in permanent magnets of a coaxial magnetic gear
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In the present work, eddy current losses in permanent magnets of a coaxial magnetic gear construction are estimated. Transient finite element method model is implemented for eddy currents calculation in dynamic operational mode. Simulations in different rotational speeds are performed and results for the eddy currents demagnetization effect over the torque conversion are presented.

articleTitle: Distributed Environment for Model-Based Design of Power Electronic Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The work presents a distributed environment for model-based design of power electronic devices. It is based on the use of an information model of the devices. The goal is to use a model-based design to create a flexible distributed system with minimization of the hardware resources used. With using an information models, software systems are being integrated and used in different scientific fields with appropriate program interfaces. This approach allows the automation of the design process, which is consisted of connected multiple repetitive operations. In this way, the results are structured in a platform independent database.

articleTitle: Lighting control system for public premises, based on evolutionary optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Energy efficiency together with user satisfaction are the two major considerations in the contemporary lighting systems. Satisfying these considerations is only possible through lighting control. The current paper presents a lighting control system which operation is based on genetic algorithm optimization. The objective of the optimization task is the maximum use of the natural daylight, thus making the need of complementary artificial light minimum. At the same time the lighting control system is designed so that it meets the occupants' lighting preferences. The hardware of the proposed system consists of simple controllers and allows both on/off lighting control and dimming of the light sources. Also for assuring correct operation of the lighting control system, the implementation of two photo sensors is considered - one for measurement of the vertical illuminance and another one for measurement of the horizontal illuminance outdoors.

articleTitle: Induction crucible furnace with reactive power nonsymmetrical compensation of inductor sections
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The article deals with the design and power scheme of an induction crucible furnace with a capacity of 10 tons for steel from a dual frequency converter. A comparison of dynamics of the melt homogenization process in furnace of the proposed design with a similar process in a conventional furnace is compared. Calculations showed that at the same power, the speed of metal movement in the bath increased more than 6 times, and the rate of temperature equalization increased more than 10-fold due to change in metal flow trajectory in the bath.

articleTitle: Influence of the Current-Carrying Elements Material on the Thermal Field Distribution in a Low Voltage Switchboard
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents numerical studies of the influence exerted by the material of the current-carrying elements in a low voltage switchboard (LVS) on the level of heating in it. The studies have been conducted by means of especially developed computer models of the LVS in Comsol. The tests have been carried out both for a closed switchboard and a switchboard with ventilation openings in case of natural and forced convection. Results about the heating in the switchboards have been obtained for the following two cases: copper or aluminum elements, which carry electric current in the LVS.

articleTitle: Experimental results on the use of flux concentrators in an IPT system
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents a critical evaluation of different approaches for designing the magnetic system of an inductive WPT (IPT). The common question that need to be addressed, early on, from the designer is will there be any benefits when the magnetic system includes a flux concentrator. This paper considers a FEA of a magnetic design with or without flux concentrators. The self-inductance is kept the same, so it can be applied to the designed power converter for the experimental results. Simulational data for the magnetic coupling, mutual inductance and the resulting magnetic field are given. Experimental verification of the results is also given, along with some additional comments on the influence the magnetic design has on electrical operation of the power converter.

articleTitle: Survey on Regenerative Energy Potential of Athens Trolleybuses
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Inverter-Fed asynchronous machines are widely used in high power electric vehicles, such as electric trains and trolleybuses.
