The use of vector control in those public transportation systems has gained popularity due to its advantages in terms of energy conversion, reliability and quality of transportation. In addition, recent advances in operation and control of regenerative braking schemes give the opportunity to enhance public transportation through energy saving in a sustainable manner; the aim of this paper is to present initial estimations regarding the sustainability of applying a regenerative braking scheme in case of Athens trolleybuses (owned by OSY S.A.).

articleTitle: Performance of an Active Power Filter when Combined with Static Compensation Units under non-Linear Loads
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Effective performance of active power filters when combined with static compensation units operated in the power system with nonlinear loads has been considered in this article. The paper presents therefore, results of selected experimental and simulation studies to specify the conditions and the risks of such cooperation. On the basis of the results obtained, respective conclusions and recommendations for practice are formulated.

articleTitle: Improvement in Characteristics of Linear Generators for Wave Energy Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel topology of linear electrical generators with permanent magnets for a wave energy plant. A comparison of existing and proposed topologies is done. The analysis is based on the static 3-D magnetic field modelling and dynamic simulation using equivalent circuits. The results show that the proposed topology has higher power per mass of the magnetic system.

articleTitle: Approach to Prediction the Transition of a Small Power Low Voltage Switching Arc into Glowing
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The aim of the article was to consider the results of experimental investigations of the switching arc to glow transformation and their comparison to the theoretical considerations performed previously. On this basis, it was possible to draw practical conclusions regarding the control of this effect in low voltage (<;250V) inductive circuits of an energy not over 10J. The theoretical evaluation of the arc instability conditions was used as a key factor.

Author Keywords: low voltage and low power installation

articleTitle: Risk Management in the Field Electrostatic Charge
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In order to determine the amount of electrostatic charge and its impact on technological processes and people, the following risk management is proposed. Risk assessment includes tests of the electrostatic charge with the measurement of the electrostatic field and conductor continuity, processing data obtained by measuring, and ultimately analyzing the obtained results as well as suggestions for reducing and eliminating the risk posed by static charge.

articleTitle: Investigation of Two-Stage Inverter Supply for Pulse Arc Welding
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper discusses the principle of operation and obtained results of analysis of an autonomous inverter supply for pulse induction arc welding based on two stages. In the investigated inverter supply the DC/AC block consists of two separate inverters. The first inverter provides the necessary current for the welding process and the second inverter is intended to support the ignition of the arc. Useful design recommendations are obtained for dimensioning of the circuit. The carried out PSPICE analysis includes different operation modes and transition between the starting mode and the nominal mode. The transformer realization is discussed based on a nanocrystalline magnetic material core.

articleTitle: Parallel Simulations in the Static Multiphysics Analysis of RF - MEMS Switches
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The main objective of this paper is to develop a parallel algorithm aiming to reduce the computational time required to solve coupled multiphysics problems that arise in the RF -MEMS switches elasto-static analysis so that their consequent model order reduction can be carried out more efficiently.

articleTitle: Arc-Flash Risk Level Calculations based on Computer Simulations and Measures to Avoid Hazards
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Safety of the electricity distribution personnel during maintenance, repair, test, and measurement in the distribution areas is in the thread of the energy of the electric arcs due to potential short circuit faults. Unfortunately, every year people are injured, burned or killed because of these accidents. In parallel with population increase at metropolitan cities, short circuit levels of the power system, and thereby arc-flash risk levels, increase. This study provides a general overview of the arc-flash analysis and measures to avoid hazards. Arc flash hazard levels are calculated based on computer simulations which are performed by DigSilent PowerFactory power system analysis software. IEEE 1584 and NFPA 70 standards are considered in assessing the simulation results. Temporary change of relay coordination technique (temporary maintenance switching) is investigated as a solution for the substations in which arc-flash hazard level is beyond acceptable levels. Numerical analysis are performed for several medium and low voltage substations in the territory of EnerjiSA Distribution Companies in Turkey.

articleTitle: Protection of Information Transmitted in the Management System of Earthmoving and Constraction Machines
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper we are taking a look at the topic of data protection in the automated operation control system of earth-moving and construction machines. As a result of the research, a device was created, based on the hybrid principle of data encryption with several encryption levels. This device operates in the standard frequency range of any mobile communication system. Operation modeling of this device in operation control system of earthmoving and construction machines was carried out.

articleTitle: Influence of underground cable lines for high voltage on the behavior of electric power system
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In the recent years, many electric power companies have introduced cable lines for high and extra-high voltage and have studied the effect of their implementation on their power grids. The transmission network is dynamic and it is constantly evolving, as the underground cable lines can be used for its expansion, as well as for replacing the existing overhead transmission lines (OHL) in highly urbanized places. The report presents the necessary approaches in the study of transition processes in cable electric lines for the influence on power system in the process of their operation.

articleTitle: Vibration and collision detection technique
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The present paper addresses a novel approach in solution of the issues related with monitoring of impact and vibrations on the surface of sensitive equipment. The aim is to establish the presence of kinematic changes in the contours of a monitored object caused by the contact with another mass body as well as establishment of the magnitude and the mass of the influence. It is based on frequency domain analysis of acoustic sensor readings. Practical measurements verify the technique.

articleTitle: Induction heat treatment of steel products with group work of static frequency converters
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Effective numerical models of induction heat treatment with group work of static frequency converters are developed. They include two-dimensional modeling of coupling electromagnetic and temperature fields in cylindrical systems for processing of tubes and rolls and connecting them with models of inverters. Also thermal tension during heating and cooling of tubes and rolls are simulated. These data allow defining structure, hardness, the size of grain and other properties of the tubes and rolls. They allow optimizing design and a choice of equipment, a heat treatment mode for the purpose of achievement of the maximum quality and minimization of energy consumption. The developed models were used not only for the design of induction heat treatment systems of tubes and rolls, but also for a digital control of these complexes.

articleTitle: Humidity Sensors Based on Doped Titania-Silica Surface Layers
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper proposes humidity sensors on the base of Ti-Si-Ce-Zn-Cu-O surface layers, developed using a sol-gel technology and a thermal treatment at 400°C or 800°C. Titanium (IV) n-butoxide and polydimethylsiloxane have been used as titania and silica precursors. Cerium is included in the resulting system via a saturated liquid solution of diammonium hexanitrocerate in isobutanol. It provides sufficiently acidic environment for the running of the hydrolysis processes in the sol-gel system. Zinc nitrate hexahydrate and copper (II) nitrate trihydrate have been used as dopant sources of Zn and Cu. The electrical characteristics, topological features and chemical compositions of the obtained layers have been studied. The frequency characteristics of the samples have been investigated for frequencies from 20 Hz to 1 MHz. The sensitivity of the proposed sensors regarding the environment humidity is significant. The resistance variation of the sensors, sintered at 800°C, amounts to five orders of magnitude in the entire relative humidity range between 17% and 90%, registered at 20 Hz and at a temperature of 25°C.

articleTitle: Vision-Based Position Regulation of Differential-Drive Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper considers the problem of vision-based stabilization (a stopping maneuver) of nonholonomic differential-drive mobile robots. First, a camera-robot model suitable for control applications is developed. Using a look-ahead approach, a vision-based feedback controller is proposed, which stabilizes the robot at a desired position indicated by a static circular marker on the line to follow. An algorithm for circle detection based on Hough transform is presented for determining the pose of the robot with respect to a detected stopping landmark. Simulation and experimental results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Polar to Cartesian Interpolation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The registration of the ISAR (Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar) signal in a two-dimensional (2D) polar grid and its interpolation to Cartesian coordinates is a problem while for image reconstruction a fast Fourier transform (FFT) is required. Normally, this ISAR problem is not considered due to short length of the synthetic aperture and comparably small sizes of the targets. The present work is intended to fill in the gab in the literature in respect of polar interpolation of the ISAR signal. For this purpose, ISAR signal formation with polar to Cartesian interpolation is analytically described and graphically illustrated. LFM (Liner Frequency Modulation) ISAR signal model is used to derive the main polar to Cartesian transformation equations.

articleTitle: Comparison of Wind Data Measurment Results of LIDAR Device and Calibrated Cup Anemometers Mounted on a Met Mast
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper measurement results of a LIDAR device are compared to those from calibrated cup anemometers mounted on a met mast. The correlations of wind speeds give very good results at all evaluated heights.

articleTitle: Hybrid System Sizing using per unit Approach - Application to Bulgaria, France and Romania
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents the application of per unit approach for sizing of hybrid system with renewable energy sources. The system is combination of photovoltaic and wind generators and operates in parallel with the grid. The per unit approach is applied to different installation sites in Bulgaria, France and Romania using the respective country specific load. Different combinations of the hybrid system for each site are studied to determine the most balanced system.

articleTitle: Lighting Energy Savings through Implementation of Lighting Control System Based on Evolutionary optimisation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Technologies nowadays are developing in a fast pace. A lot of complicated lighting control systems are developed, but still they are not welcomed by the occupants in public premises. Most of the efficient lighting control strategies are also very expensive and are not cost effective. The current paper presents an analysis of the lighting energy savings accomplished in an office by implementation of a lighting control system (realized by simple controllers), executing genetic algorithm for maximum use of daylight. The energy consumption for lighting is monitored for a period of two months and the real energy savings, accomplished by the implemented lighting control system are compared to their predetermined values and also to the energy consumption for lighting before the implementation of lighting control.

articleTitle: Development of the Mathematical Model for the Calculation of Electrical Characteristics of Induction Crucible Furnace of Conductive with Ferromagnetic Tygle with Two-Layer Loading
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: A mathematical model is developed for the electric calculation of induction crucible furnaces with a conductive crucible in the ELCUT package. Electrical and power characteristics of the furnace were obtained depending on the frequency, temperature and current of the inductor. The calculated values were verified experimentally.

articleTitle: Estimation of Series Resistance of Transformer Winding to Study Transient Phenomena
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Exact determination of frequency and amplitude of resonance points in the frequency response is very important for fast transient analysis of a transformer winding. The accuracy of series resistance has significant role to determine the weakening of oscillations in a winding of a transformer. In this paper a novel method is used for estimation of series resistance in detailed model of transformer winding. In this regard, series resistance of the transformer winding is estimated by an exponential function. The proposed method improves input-output response beside the internal behavior of the winding. The results of the current essay have been validated with experimental tests.

articleTitle: Implementation of a DC current sensing transformer with H-bridge MOSFET rectifier in a resonant LLC converter
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents experimental implementation and tests the efficacy of a current feedback circuit for an LLC resonant convertor, working as a battery charger. The circuit is based on a current transformer and a second H-bridge which is synchronised with the first side H-bridge of the converter. The proposed solution, along with all mandatory requirements such as galvanic isolation, stability, fast response, offers intermittent synchronisation between the full bridge of the converter and the feedback circuit. The paper clarifies the application of the proposed current sense circuit as a current feedback loop, which is part of a digital control system. The implementation of the current measurement circuit is shown and proved experimentally.

articleTitle: Experimental study of the influence of operation of the twelve-pulse transformer with bridge rectifiers of the harmonic composition on the primary current
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this work, the influence of the operation of a twelve-pulse transformer with bridge rectifiers on the harmonic composition of the primary current is analysed, comparison of obtained and theoretical.

Author Keywords: bridge rectifiers and the coefficient of harmonic distortion

articleTitle: Hybrid design of magnetoelectric position sensor with CAN compatibility
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the study of magnetoelectric crankshaft position sensor with signal processing based on symmetrical magnetostrictive-piezoelectric layered structure, material of piezoceramic PZT - Metglas composition. Proposed sensor would have the advantages against the traditional sensors such as smaller size and weight. Piezoceramic composite in our case had length of 70 mm, width of 12 mm and thickness of 0,5 mm; Metglas length of 70 mm, width was of 12 mm and thickness of one layer is 0,02 mm. The designed sensor with signal processing and CAN bus simplifies integration into automotive electronics and improves the characteristics of the previously proposed magnetoelectric crankshaft position sensors.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Verification of LLC Operating Regimes
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents a study of the operating regimes of a LLC resonant converter using mathematical models and real hardware measurements for verification. The various operation waveforms are taken with varying the load, thus changing the output parameters (current, voltage and power) of the converter. The parameters of the circuit elements that are loaded in the model are the same as of the evaluation board TMDSHVRESLLCKIT from Texas Instruments. The results from the internal study of this board's operating regimes are used to verify the results produced from the resonant converter model.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Method of Self Clustering Algorithm Using Self Organizing Map Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper describes an approach of self clustering algorithm using hierarchical Self Organizing Map neural network. In the basic SOM algorithm the user should enter the number of clusters before its training, here we give different approach of representing only the data set and the network should create clusters according to the data topology. In order to do it there are several steps that have to be done. At first the data is clustered according hierarchical approach in this way we obtain data set tree, where each node represents a cluster and each cluster includes some data from the data set. The method is hierarchical[3], [4] because it starts from one cluster if one cluster is not enough then clusters are increased into two and so on until the algorithm stops creating clusters. The term self clustering means that the number of clusters are not determined before learning trial their number depends on the data and the algorithm determines their number.

articleTitle: Bidirectional DAB DC-DC Converter with Predictive Hysteresis Current Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: A simulation model that realize hysteresis current mode control (without current comparators) for Bidirectional Dual Active Bridge (BDAB), called Predictive Hysteresis Current Mode Control (PHCMC), is proposed in the present paper. Buck and Boost modes of operation are developed in the MATLAB/SIMULINK environment. 3D finite element analysis has been employed for modelling the electromagnetic field of the transformer and its leakage inductance calculation using COMSOL Multiphysics® program.

articleTitle: Non - contact selection of power from eleclric transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Power supply devices for monitoring systems, light fencing, relay protection and emergency automatics of high voltage air electric networks, in particular, a capacitive power take-off from a high-voltage three-phase power transmission line placed a safe distance along the line wires, and an antenna connected to an electromagnetic device are considered. The results of the analysis show a sufficiently high efficiency of the considered power supply system in comparison with other methods of power takeoff from high-voltage transmission lines.

Author Keywords: non-contact selection of power from high-voltage power lines

articleTitle: Economic Assessment of Lithium-Ion Battery Storage Systems in the Nearly Zero Energy Building Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 20th International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Scope of this paper is to deliver a complete techno-economic model for the economic assessment of lithium-ion battery energy storage systems in the framework of the nearly zero energy buildings (NZEB). The proposed model simulates the combined operation of photovoltaics, solar thermal generators, heat pump generators, electrical and thermal storage devices in order to represent efficiently the typical characteristics of NZEBs. The model takes into account the thermal and electrical needs of the building, typical electricity prices, household electrical consumption profiles, weather data and typical costs for lithium battery energy storage systems. Using these inputs, an optimization procedure is applied and the optimal size, in terms of net present value, for the lithium-ion battery energy storage system is derived.
